Basics of strategic management of municipalities at the municipal level (allowance 2/0)
Act on Municipalities, Administrative Procedure Code; strategic and regional planning - social and economic aspects of planning (allowance 2/0)

Countryside - definition of countryside and rural settlements, characteristics of the countryside, history and present of the Czech countryside, context of the demographic situation in the countryside (allowance 2/0)
Urbanism in rural areas, folk architecture of the CR region; rural economic base (allowance 2/0)
Production sector in rural areas, possibilities and limits of tertiary development in rural areas (allowance 2/0)
Contemporary countryside and housing, differentiation of the Czech countryside, problems of peripheral and marginal regions, problems of small and very small settlements (allowance 2/0)
Possibilities of rural revitalization - functional development, housing, protection of historical and natural heritage (allowance 2/0)
Landscape and agriculture - placement of the seat in the landscape, the relationship between the seat and the landscape (allowance 2/0)
Soil, protection of agricultural land, possibilities of integral solution of settlement and landscape within KPÚ (allowance 2/0)
Suburbanization and its threats to the countryside - rural urbanization; sub-urbanization: history, relation to cities, countryside and traditions (allowance 2/0)

City and its arrangement - basic urban terminology, functional structure of the city, general characteristics of individual functional components; transport - calming of roads, pedestrian and bicycle transport, design and modification of traffic areas, modification of the space ensuring the use of persons with limited mobility and orientation (allowance 2/0)
Civic and technical equipment of the city, regeneration and renewal of central parts of cities and their public areas (allowance 2/0)
Territorial policy and development operational programs, Rural renewal. subsidy programs of the Czech Republic, EU structural funds, related legislation (allowance 2/0)
Presentation, written test (allowance 2/0)

rural economic base (allowance 2/0)5.Production sector in rural areas, possibilities and limits of tertiary development in rural areas (allowance 2/0)6.Contemporary countryside and housing, differentiation of the Czech countryside, problems of peripheral and marginal regions, problems of small and very small settlements (allowance 2/0)7.Possibilities of rural revitalization - functional development, housing, protection of historical and natural heritage (allowance 2/0)8.Landscape and agriculture - placement of the seat in the landscape, the relationship between the seat and the landscape (allowance 2/0)9.Soil, protection of agricultural land, possibilities of integral solution of settlement and landscape within KPÚ (allowance 2/0)10.Suburbanization and its threats to the countryside - rural urbanization; sub-urbanization: history, relation to cities, countryside and traditions (allowance 2/0)11.City and its arrangement - basic urban terminology, functional structure of the city, general characteristics of individual functional components; transport - calming of roads, pedestrian and bicycle transport, design and modification of traffic areas, modification of the space ensuring the use of persons with limited mobility and orientation (allowance 2/0)12.Civic and technical equipment of the city, regeneration and renewal of central parts of cities and their public areas (allowance 2/0)13.Territorial policy and development operational programs, Rural renewal. subsidy programs of the Czech Republic, EU structural funds, related legislation (allowance 2/0)14.Presentation, written test (allowance 2/0)
